Hello, my Bitforturn BS-1 (5.1 TH/s) was delivered on September 17, 2026.
It suddenly stopped working. The fan only moves slightly and stops, and I
noticed a burnt smell and black marks near the yellow power connector on
the miner.

I have disconnected it from power and have not tried to turn it on again.

Could you please advise me on how to proceed with a warranty claim or
repair? I can provide photos and my order number (Shop····).
Note to the team: Verdict recorded as defective; the chat is back with Sarah for the return decision.

Hi Sarah,

Thank you for approving my warranty claim and for offering the Hammer Miner
BC04 as a replacement. I appreciate the upgrade and your help resolving
this issue.

I confirm that the BC04 works for me, and I confirm that it should be
shipped to the same address as my original order:

(address hidden), (address hidden)
(address hidden)
Israel

Please go ahead and arrange the shipment. I look forward to receiving the
tracking number.

Best regards,
Tommy
